key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.summary: Show the track in the top bar
key.description: Show the current track's artist and title in the top bar while it is playing or paused. The item is hidden when the player stops or none is running, whatever this is set to.

key.name: panel-max-chars
key.description: The widest the top bar label may grow, in characters. Longer text is cut short with an ellipsis.

key.name: pinned-player
key.description: The player to follow instead of whichever is playing, as its MPRIS bus name without the org.mpris.MediaPlayer2. prefix or any .instance suffix — "spotify", say. Empty follows the active player.
